svg.text: DWG-27-012_plf_body PORT LATCH FOOT BODY, 6061-T6, 4 OFF (one part; the passenger side is the same part rotated 180 deg)
stem (through the foot pocket, into the port).62 x 26, z -28 .. 24.5 (PROVISIONAL)
seat flange (the pad STOP)....................80 x 40 x 4.0; top z 4.00 +0/-0.05, underside z 0 (bears on the rail cap)
hook slider cross-slot........................53 wide, z -23.5 .. -12.0; floor/roof parallel 0.03
pin channels (2)..............................12 wide at x +/-12.5, u -1 .. 9, open at the stem bottom (the stem drops past the pins)
lock bore.....................................19.2 H11 x 28.7 deep from the inboard face, axis // u, z 50; cam pocket 22
detent bore...................................M8x1.25 (tap 6.8) in the +x ear, 16 deep, 7.5 above the hinge axis
finish........................................hard anodise Type III clear; seat flange, slot floor, ear faces ground / masked
1. EVERY dimension that touches the port (stem, channels, pin height, slot) is PROVISIONAL: Rivian publishes neither the port nor the crossbar foot. Calibration P-CAL-01b before release.
2. Rivian forbids modifying the ports: nothing here cuts or drills the truck.
3. Stem depth leaves 2 mm above the (provisional) recess floor; the SEAT FLANGE, not the stem, sets height.
NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION. Uncalibrated against the physical vehicle. No FEA performed.
